page_title: GEN 1-1 COM | Genoa v Como 07/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Van der Brempt I. Muscle Injury

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
90+5' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fabio Miretti leaves the pitch and Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa) comes on.
90+2' 1 - 1 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Andrea Pinamonti knock down. 1:1.
90+2' Genoa force a corner. They send men into the box.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Alieu Fadera will be replaced by Alessio Iovine (Como).
90' Substitution. Gabriel Strefezza will be replaced by Simone Verdi (Como).
89' Como take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
89' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save. Corner kick. Como will have an opportunity.
86' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Johan Vasquez (Genoa) was quite harsh and Antonio Rapuano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' Como failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' Here is a change. Patrick Cutrone is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Andrea Belotti (Como).
84' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the right post.
82' It is time for a substitution. Matthias Braunoder (Como) is on for Lucas Da Cunha.
82' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Marco Sala (Como) replaces Alberto Moreno.
82' Como are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
81' Here comes a substitution. Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) is brought on as a substitute for Stefano Sabelli.
79' Today's referee Antonio Rapuano rightly decides to book Mario Balotelli (Genoa) for his harsh tackle.
79' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
75' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it well wide of the left post.
73' Alberto Moreno (Como) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Antonio Rapuano ignores the protests.
72' The manager makes a subsitution with Gaston Pereiro (Genoa) coming on for Morten Frendrup.
72' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Jeff Ekhator is replaced by Mario Balotelli (Genoa).
67' The goal by Como is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
67' The Como players halt their celebrations as referee Antonio Rapuano makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
67' It's a goal and Patrick Cutrone (Como) is the scorer!
66' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
61' This is a yellow card! Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
61' Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
58' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Pepe Reina as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
57' A player from Como commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
53' A cross from Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
50' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Genoa comes to nothing.
50' A cross into the box from Fabio Miretti (Genoa) is cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Genoa.
49' Como keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
46' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
46' Alberto Gilardino makes a half-time substitution. Fabio Miretti comes on in place of Aaron Martin (Genoa).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' It's a nice effort by Alan Matturro (Genoa) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Pepe Reina. Easy save.
45+1' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Antonio Rapuano interrupts the game. One of the players from Como won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
42' A cross from a corner kick by Genoa is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
41' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' None of the Genoa players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
39' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) wasted a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the right post.
39' Como are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
36' Aaron Martin (Genoa) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Pepe Reina makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
32' Aaron Martin (Genoa) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
31' A player from Genoa commits a rough challenge. Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
29' A corner kick by Como is thwarted by the well prepared Nicola Leali (Genoa).
28' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Como force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
27' A cross from a corner kick by Como is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

26' A cross is whipped into the box by Gabriel Strefezza (Como) and Alieu Fadera controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention. Como force their opponents to concede a corner.
26' It's a throw-in after the ball crosses the sideline.
24' A player from Genoa brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
22' Como seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
17' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Lucas Da Cunha (Como) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Nico Paz provided an assist for the goal.
17' Como can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
17' Nico Paz (Como) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Nicola Leali. Como win a corner.
16' Genoa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
14' Nico Paz (Como) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
14' The game is pretty dull as Como are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
13' Como exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
10' Nico Paz (Como) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.

10' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) clutches his head in despair after blowing a huge opportunity! He receives the ball from the set piece and takes a good first touch to unleash a low shot, but Nicola Leali makes a nice save.
8' The referee blows his whistle as Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) was too aggressive in his challenge.
6' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
4' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

4' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner.
3' Como are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
1' The Como players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Como will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Antonio Rapuano.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
